# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> Community-maintained open-source AI coding desktop. Desktop 5.0.1 uses public `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`, prioritizes reliable upgrades and is published as one version across Windows, macOS and Linux. Native tests, packaging and smoke checks passed on all three platforms.

## Canonical identity

- Product: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
- Version: 5.0.1, published 2026-10-06 UTC
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 x64 stable; macOS Apple Silicon arm64 Preview; Linux x64 Preview
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Maintainer: ningbai牛逼
- Not an official DeepSeek product

## 5.1.0 candidate preparation — not published

- Status: local unsigned Windows x64 beta evidence only, dated 2026-10-23. Public stable downloads and global homepage release metadata remain 5.0.1. Authorization for an unsigned three-platform release is not proof that publication or its native gates have completed.
- Candidate stack: official NPM Runtime/SDK 0.2.1-rc.2 and Electron 44.0.0, without official-source changes. macOS candidate requires Apple Silicon arm64 and macOS 13 Ventura or later, remains unsigned/unnotarized Preview; Linux x64 remains Preview. Windows evidence does not establish either platform's acceptance.
- Changes: consumer-acknowledged streaming backpressure without truncation; asynchronous authorized frontend reads; prompt HMR graph rescans; installation-directory discovery and transactional registry recovery; first-use market consent and recoverable source replacement. Market feedback, translation, automatic updates and project-layout scanning default off; translation may send documents to a model, feedback may open a public GitHub Issue, and activation consent is not a sandbox.
- Simplified frameless Dock/settings retain all 15 destinations, search, controls, advanced details, critical risk notices, selection, keyboard focus and saved configuration. Dedicated settings documents exclude the floating pet and rail; the main conversation pet and its settings remain available. Existing chat, plugins, Skills, model access, independent APIs, tray behavior and 15 skins remain.
- Local beta evidence: actual Setup-extracted payload core regression 28/28, streaming tests 99/99, settings tests 314/314; Desktop unit tests 1884 total, 1882 passed, zero failed, two existing skips. These are candidate records, not final release-commit verification. No general speedup or cold-start percentage is established.
- Still required: clean-runner real Setup fresh installation, separate 4.3.0/5.0.0/5.0.1 upgrades, same-version overlay and data preservation; native macOS/Linux checks; final Release assets and exact checksums. Local isolated fixtures do not prove physical installation/rollback, and Electron-boundary consent simulation does not prove physical-dialog clicks. No 5.1.0 formal installer hash or publication date is claimed here.
- Candidate notes: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/blob/main/docs/launch/release-notes.md
- Candidate screenshot provenance: https://1521003.xyz/assets/desktop-5.1.0-candidate-sources.json (local Windows native-window images, not cloud/final-release or other-platform captures; image hashes are not installer hashes).

## Published 5.0.1

- New profiles use the official appearance while upgrades retain skins and explicit preferences. Streaming avoids repeated sidebar scans without truncating text, code or tool output; this is not a guarantee of stall-free behavior on every device.
- Sidebar tools collapse, expand by keyboard and persist across restart; the footer Dock and Today spending are the sole primary shortcuts. Opaque light/dark Dock panels clear stale palettes and retain all 15 destinations, search and focus.
- The App menu supports tray minimization, restoration, explicit exit and taskbar fallback. Windows updates recognize existing installation directories and retain transactional backup and rollback.
- Current screenshots are isolated Windows captures of the same-release-commit candidate, not macOS/Linux screenshots or physical-device acceptance; configuration captures combine simultaneous real host and embedded WebContents views.

- Desktop 5.0.1 uses official NPM Runtime 0.2.0-rc.2 with public dsh-web-all 0.4.4 and reviewed Desktop adapters. Release run 37499057103 passed all three native platform jobs; Windows packaged regression passed 43/43, source regression 27/27, with fresh installation, 4.3.0 and 5.0.0 upgrades, same-version overlays and data-preserving relaunch on disposable runners. Other installed versions and physical macOS/Linux devices are not covered by those checks.
- bai authorization discovers and refreshes the actual model catalog, preferring available deepseek-flash. Authentication errors offer browser sign-in; there is no automatic payment or resend.
- Official builds include anonymous, opt-out product metrics; conversation content, prompts, code, paths and API keys are not collected.
- Large histories use authenticated fragmentation and complete reassembly without truncating messages or tool output. A logical message exceeding 32 MiB fails explicitly.
- Configuration preservation, Skin Center stylesheet ownership and 4.4.0 branding are included. Dock, third-party model integration and Skills remain available.
- Optional manual context summaries require user review; history is not uploaded automatically and no paid model is called automatically.
- Historical 4.0.0 screenshots and release links below are retained as version-labelled evidence. Confirm the actual GitHub Release before downloading; installer size and SHA-256 must come from that exact artifact.

## What is new in 4.0.0

- The manual terminal offers PowerShell, PowerShell 7, WSL, and CMD on Windows; Agent WSL is a separate opt-in tool with per-command approval by default.
- Agent Team, Browser Use, and Computer Use changes preflight the plugin environment and report restart or rollback progress.
- Automatic update checks defer while offline and back off after classified failures; manual checks remain available.
- Verified 4.x in-place upgrades retain the user's custom installation directory.

- Browser Use: official Playwright MCP by default, visible isolated sessions, system Chrome/Edge/Chromium discovery, approval-gated actions.
- Computer Use: bundled Cua Driver Native by default, external MCP fallback, permission discovery, observation/action separation, safe-mode recovery.
- Runtime: exact DSH 0.1.6 alpha.2 graph and source-verified dsh-web 0.3.23 cohort, with Desktop compatibility boundaries preserved.
- Migration: transactional 4.1 backup, fingerprint, idempotency, rollback, and long-context restoration.
- Extensions: informed risk-install path remains available after isolated preflight and rollback checks.
- Privacy: control telemetry is fixed-vocabulary only and excludes URLs, domains, page content, window names, screenshots, prompts, tool arguments, paths, and credentials.

## Release boundary

Windows is intentionally unsigned. macOS is unsigned and unnotarized. macOS and Linux are Preview platforms. One GitHub Release is created only after all three platform jobs succeed; GitHub Pages is deployed only after its download URLs are verified.
